manifest_binding.canonicalization: exact manifest.json bytes are compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON without trailing newline; duplicate keys and unknown fields reject
manifest_binding.entry_ids: derive in manifest entry order from entries[].id; require exactly r60-h01, r60-h02, r60-h03, r60-h04
manifest_binding.expected_member_names: manifest.json, oracle.json, hashes.json, every exact asset-reference value, assets/, and every slash-terminated ancestor directory of each asset reference; no other name
manifest_binding.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact validated manifest.json bytes
manifest_binding.private_manifest_commitment_sha256: exactly SHA-256 of the exact validated manifest.json bytes
manifest_binding.timing: after complete raw archive validation, read exact manifest.json payload bytes from that validated archive before deriving entry_ids and expected_member_names

member_name_digest.input: compact canonical sorted JSON array of exact unnormalized UTF-8 member names

member_names.equality: actual raw-header member-name set equals the manifest-derived exact expected member-name set byte-for-byte without normalization

raw_ustar_checks: require each exact member name to be strict UTF-8 of length 1 through 100 bytes; bytes 0:100 are the exact name bytes followed by NUL padding and prefix bytes 345:500 are all NUL; reject longer names
require mode bytes 100:108 exactly b'0000600\0' for a regular file or b'0000700\0' for a directory
require uid bytes 108:116 and gid bytes 116:124 each exactly b'0000000\0'
require size bytes 124:136 to be exactly eleven lowercase octal digits plus NUL; directory size is exactly zero

require checksum bytes 148:156 to be exactly six lowercase octal digits plus NUL plus space; compute the checksum as the unsigned sum of all 512 header bytes after substituting eight ASCII spaces for bytes 148:156 and require exact equality
require typeflag byte 156 exactly ASCII '0' for a regular file or ASCII '5' for a directory
require linkname bytes 157:257, uname bytes 265:297, gname bytes 297:329, devmajor bytes 329:337, devminor bytes 337:345, prefix bytes 345:500, and final bytes 500:512 all NUL
require magic bytes 257:263 exactly b'ustar\0' and version bytes 263:265 exactly b'00'
require each regular-file payload to contain exactly the declared size followed by NUL padding through the next 512-byte boundary; directories have size zero and no payload
require exactly two terminal 512-byte zero blocks followed immediately by EOF with no trailing bytes
reject every extension header and unknown type
same_archive_object_proof: open one plaintext archive descriptor and retain its initial descriptor-held inode, size, and mtime metadata
validate complete raw USTAR bytes and record the prevalidated archive SHA-256 and declared archive byte length
after validation lseek the exact archive descriptor to offset zero
stream exactly the declared archive byte length from that descriptor to age stdin while independently hashing and counting streamed bytes
require streamed SHA-256 and count to equal the prevalidated SHA-256 and size, require EOF immediately after the declared length, and require age success
lseek the same descriptor to offset zero, rehash it, and require the same SHA-256 plus unchanged descriptor-held inode, size, and mtime before publishing the layout receipt

live_checks: no related runner process remains live
the fixed plaintext root is absent
cleanup_validation.required_receipt_sha_binding: terminal cleanup_receipt_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the descriptor-opened current cleanup receipt

authorization.failure: no artifact; G004 remains in_progress; G005 remains pending

bindings.successor_b0_sha: requested B0 == detached clean HEAD after the exact eight-path allowed change set

access_contract.receipt_resolution: open and read every receipt descriptor-relative to the retained public-root descriptor; never reopen by absolute path
access_contract.stability_scope: retain the public-root and every opened receipt descriptor through validation and require each descriptor's device, inode, uid, gid, mode, ACL, size, and mtime_ns unchanged before/after

descriptor_open.exact_acl: implementation user read/readattr only; containing directory search/readattr only; no other non-owner grant
descriptor_open.public_root: open once with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW; require owner koharu-custody, mode 0700, not symlink, implementation user search/readattr only, and no other non-owner grant; retain through validation
descriptor_open.receipt_resolution: all receipt reads use the retained public-root descriptor and fixed filenames; retain each opened receipt descriptor through validation

successor successor_b0_sha equals requested B0 and detached clean HEAD
successor public_commitment_sha256 equals exact public commitment bytes
successor contract_sha256 and test_spec_sha256 equal exact frozen bytes
layout receipt SHA-256 equals public and successor layout_receipt_sha256
layout receipt ciphertext_sha256 equals public and successor ciphertext_sha256
layout receipt layout_validator_sha256 equals public and successor layout_validator_sha256

layout receipt member_name_digest_sha256 equals public and successor member_name_digest_sha256

bindings.runtime_receipt_sha256: SHA-256 of exact current runtime receipt bytes
bindings.start_marker_sha256: SHA-256 of exact current start receipt bytes
bindings.successor_commitment_sha256: SHA-256 of exact preflight successor commitment bytes

semantics.completed_fail: a classified preflight, runtime, or formal failure with cleanup evidence; non-authorizing and no artifact
semantics.completed_pass: all eight fixed CPU/actual-Metal cells and cleanup pass; sole authorizing state
semantics.fresh: all fixed receipts except start/runtime/terminal/cleanup are preflight-valid and no start marker exists
semantics.incomplete_non_authorizing: crash, unknown state, missing or drifted evidence, or unproved cleanup; no artifact
semantics.started: create-new marker exists; revision is permanently consumed
